<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationReport" name="Report of companies applied to"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationFeedback" name="Application confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HiringDecision" name="Hiring decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PermanentStatus" name="Permanent job status"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Applicant_Start" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Applicant_SendApplication" name="Write and send job application" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Applicant_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to" messageRef="Message_ApplicationReport"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision" name="Receive hiring decision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_HiredGateway" name="Does the company want you to work for them?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_Probation" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Applicant_ReviewVisibilityTimer" name="One year after company rating" attachedToRef="Applicant_RateCompany" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_ReviewVisibleEnd" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" name="Receive company rating of you" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" name="Receive permanent job status" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_PermanentGateway" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" name="Did you rate the company C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_JobNotPermanentEnd" name="Job did not become permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_JobPermanentEnd" name="Job became permanent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_OfferMerge" name="Continue receiving offers"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_1" sourceRef="Applicant_Start" targetRef="Applicant_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_2" sourceRef="Applicant_SendApplication" targetRef="Applicant_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_3" sourceRef="Applicant_ReportApplications" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_4" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_5" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_6" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision" targetRef="Applicant_HiredGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_7" sourceRef="Applicant_HiredGateway" targetRef="Applicant_Probation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_8" sourceRef="Applicant_HiredGateway" targetRef="Applicant_OfferMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_9" sourceRef="Applicant_Probation" targetRef="Applicant_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_10" sourceRef="Applicant_RateCompany" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_11" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_12" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_13" sourceRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_14" sourceRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Applicant_JobNotPermanentEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_15" sourceRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" targetRef="Applicant_OfferMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_16" sourceRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" targetRef="Applicant_JobPermanentEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsAboveC</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_17" sourceRef="Applicant_OfferMerge" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_18" sourceRef="Applicant_ReviewVisibilityTimer" targetRef="Applicant_ReviewVisibleEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company — Application and employment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Company_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Company_ApplicationMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Company_ReceiveReport" name="Receive report of companies applied to" messageRef="Message_ApplicationReport"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendFeedback" name="Send confirmation and application rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_InterviewGateway" name="Is an interview negotiated?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_HiringGateway" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendPositiveDecision" name="Send hiring decision: wants applicant" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendNegativeDecision" name="Send hiring decision: does not want applicant" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_Probation" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendApplicantRating" name="Send rating of applicant" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_PermanentGateway" name="Does the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendPermanentStatus" name="Send status: job became permanent" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" name="Send status: job did not become permanent" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_NotSelectedEnd" name="Applicant not selected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_PermanentEnd" name="Job became permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_NotPermanentEnd" name="Job did not become permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_1" sourceRef="Company_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Company_ReceiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_2" sourceRef="Company_ReceiveReport" targetRef="Company_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_3" sourceRef="Company_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Company_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_4" sourceRef="Company_RateApplication" targetRef="Company_SendFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_5" sourceRef="Company_SendFeedback" targetRef="Company_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_6" sourceRef="Company_SendOffer" targetRef="Company_InterviewGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_7" sourceRef="Company_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Company_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewIsNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_8" sourceRef="Company_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Company_InterviewMerge" name="No interview negotiation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not interviewIsNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_9" sourceRef="Company_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Company_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_10" sourceRef="Company_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Company_HiringGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_11" sourceRef="Company_HiringGateway" targetRef="Company_SendPositiveDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_12" sourceRef="Company_HiringGateway" targetRef="Company_SendNegativeDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_13" sourceRef="Company_SendPositiveDecision" targetRef="Company_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_14" sourceRef="Company_SendNegativeDecision" targetRef="Company_NotSelectedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_15" sourceRef="Company_Probation" targetRef="Company_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_16" sourceRef="Company_RateApplicant" targetRef="Company_SendApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_17" sourceRef="Company_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Company_PermanentGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_18" sourceRef="Company_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Company_SendPermanentStatus">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_19" sourceRef="Company_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_20" sourceRef="Company_SendPermanentStatus" targetRef="Company_PermanentEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_21" sourceRef="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" targetRef="Company_NotPermanentEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob" name="Find a Job">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Applicant_SendApplication" targetRef="Company_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Report" name="Report of companies applied to" sourceRef="Applicant_ReportApplications" targetRef="Company_ReceiveReport" messageRef="Message_ApplicationReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Confirmation and application rating" sourceRef="Company_SendFeedback" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="Company_SendOffer" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PositiveDecision" name="Hiring decision" sourceRef="Company_SendPositiveDecision" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegativeDecision" name="Hiring decision" sourceRef="Company_SendNegativeDecision" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant" sourceRef="Company_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PermanentStatus" name="Permanent job status" sourceRef="Company_SendPermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NonPermanentStatus" name="Permanent job status" sourceRef="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationFeedback" name="Application confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HiringDecision" name="Hiring decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PermanentStatus" name="Job permanence status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob" name="Find a Job">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant" sourceRef="Company_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PermanentStatus" name="Job became permanent" sourceRef="Company_SendPermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NonPermanentStatus" name="Job did not become permanent" sourceRef="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Applicant_Start" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_SendApplication" name="Write and send job application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision" name="Receive hiring decision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_HiredGateway" name="Does the company want you to work for them?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Applicant_RatingSplit" name="Rate after probation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Applicant_ReviewVisibilityTimer" name="One year after rating" attachedToRef="Applicant_RateCompany" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_MakeReviewVisible" name="Make company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_ReviewVisibleEnd" name="Company review becomes visible"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" name="Receive company rating of you" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Applicant_RatingJoin" name="Ratings completed"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" name="Receive job permanence status" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_PermanentGateway" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" name="Did you rate the company C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_PermanentEnd" name="Job became permanent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_NotPermanentEnd" name="Job did not become permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_1" sourceRef="Applicant_Start" targetRef="Applicant_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_2" sourceRef="Applicant_SendApplication" targetRef="Applicant_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_3" sourceRef="Applicant_ReportApplications" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_4" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_5" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_6" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveHiringDecision" targetRef="Applicant_HiredGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_7" sourceRef="Applicant_HiredGateway" targetRef="Applicant_Probation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_8" sourceRef="Applicant_HiredGateway" targetRef="Applicant_SendApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_9" sourceRef="Applicant_Probation" targetRef="Applicant_RatingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_10" sourceRef="Applicant_RatingSplit" targetRef="Applicant_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_11" sourceRef="Applicant_RatingSplit" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_12" sourceRef="Applicant_RateCompany" targetRef="Applicant_RatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_13" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" targetRef="Applicant_RatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_14" sourceRef="Applicant_RatingJoin" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_15" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_16" sourceRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway">

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_19" sourceRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" targetRef="Applicant_PermanentEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsAboveC</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_20" sourceRef="Applicant_ContinueOffers" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_21" sourceRef="Applicant_ReviewVisibilityTimer" targetRef="Applicant_MakeReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="A_Flow_22" sourceRef="Applicant_MakeReviewVisible" targetRef="Applicant_ReviewVisibleEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company — Application and employment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Company_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Company_ApplicationMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendFeedback" name="Send application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_InterviewGateway" name="Is a job interview negotiated?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_HiringGateway" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendNegativeDecision" name="Send hiring decision: company does not want applicant" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant after probation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendApplicantRating" name="Send rating of applicant" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_PermanentGateway" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendPermanentStatus" name="Send status: job became permanent" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" name="Send status: job did not become permanent" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_NotSelectedEnd" name="Applicant not selected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_PermanentEnd" name="Job became permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_NotPermanentEnd" name="Job did not become permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_1" sourceRef="Company_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Company_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_2" sourceRef="Company_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Company_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_3" sourceRef="Company_RateApplication" targetRef="Company_SendFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_4" sourceRef="Company_SendFeedback" targetRef="Company_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_5" sourceRef="Company_SendOffer" targetRef="Company_InterviewGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_6" sourceRef="Company_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Company_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewIsNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="C_Flow_7" sourceRef="Company_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Company_InterviewMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not interviewIsNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
